# Institutional website narrative revision

## Scope and source

The founder requested a new bilingual hero and a ground-up restructuring of the public-site narrative after rejecting the previous organization and generic copy. This revision starts from published main `302fdcc23b6799df3ca3aac0f453015e55fe9e18` on `feat/institutional-website-narrative`.

Source material: the founder's current request, the supplied product text on business planning, modeling, institutional materials and capital connection, `MEMORIA-PRODUTO.md` and the current holistic product vision in the parent workspace. The supplied vision is not evidence that every capability is operational.

## Implemented

* Exact new hero positioning in both locales: purpose-built for those who structure and invest in debt. CFOs and companies remain a first-class audience.
* Home sequence: three-part offer, professional empowerment, three audience perspectives, finance-authored method and selective use of AI, market-informed structuring, an explorable five-stage example, and institutional consistency/control.
* Progressive disclosure for offer details, specialized methods, market relationships and institutional scope. The home is not a verbatim reproduction of the source document.
* Three audience pages distinguish applications, benefits, seniority, specialist roles and private perspectives. Each has a clearly labeled expandable working example.
* Three solution pages now expose detailed business planning, financial objectives, model building/review, scenarios, institutional materials and capital qualification, followed by a relevant interactive example.
* Five example states: start, investigate, model, prepare and connect. The model state proposes assumptions and explains the rationale before any simulation. There is no privileged scenario-analysis entry.
* Existing logo, visible city hero, finite entrance, separate dual-monitor PT/EN photography, public URLs, contact behavior and app/auth boundaries remain unchanged.

## Claim boundaries

The example is explicitly fictional, not an interactive production AI session or a customer outcome. Its financial baseline uses the existing testing fixture and financial-core; no calculation engine changed. The supplied market-relationship narrative is described as a function in the product, not evidence of a fully staffed recurring operation, a verified mandate database or confirmed counterparties. An asynchronous stage-confirmation question remains unanswered at this checkpoint.

No guarantee of funding, unconditional data protection, investor endorsement or certification is asserted. SOC 2 remains a future security objective. Advanced collaboration, templates and coordinated updates are subject to implementation-stage validation. Current organization-level access and private document storage remain linked to the security page. A financing decision remains with the relevant professional or institution.

No database, authentication, private app workflow, new dependency, provider integration, telemetry, deployment project or environment flag changed. Demo contact still explicitly prepares an email; the website does not silently submit it.

## Validation

* Repository-wide `pnpm check`: lint, typecheck, tests and all 43 build tasks passed before the final contrast-only adjustment; the complete check is repeated on the final candidate before push.
* Web suite: 106 files, 665 tests, including 17 public-website tests.
* Website coverage: exact hero; route allowlist; localized canonical URLs; page rendering; required section order; five example states; three audience drilldowns; identical new PT/EN key trees; deterministic financial baseline; certification and contact boundaries; absence of rejected punctuation and emoji arrows.
* Read-only HTTP probe: 42 localized pages, five image assets, sitemap, robots, unknown-route 404, login and unauthenticated app redirect passed. New audience and solution depth, section order and delivered interaction/reduced-motion CSS checked.
* Source accessibility review: native links, buttons and details; keyboard-visible focus; labeled selected state and content region; reduced motion; darker small-text colors. This is not browser or assistive-technology execution evidence.
* Browser interaction, responsive screenshots and actual iPhone rendering remain unverified. Browser QA was requested asynchronously and no authorization has arrived at this checkpoint. Do not infer visual acceptance from render tests or HTTP checks.

## Release and rollback

Publish through the existing repository and official Vercel project only, after the complete local check and exact-head remote Quality, security and Vercel gates. Verify the production alias and affected routes before reporting success. No new hosting project is permitted.

Previous published revision for rollback: `302fdcc23b6799df3ca3aac0f453015e55fe9e18`, deployment `dpl_HPabqEWAj5isPC7VH1im93rY8Ht2`. Rollback is a promotion of that known release or a reviewed revert of this public-site-only change. It does not require a database rollback.

The unrelated last-confirmation database ordering flake tracked by PR603 remains outside this change. Do not alter SQL, weaken assertions or imply it is fixed by the website revision.
